title: Beatrix and the Well
author: Lior Galloway
blurb: August Montrose, a hospice nurse who hears the dying count backwards, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. But when the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must finish the ritual the founders started before the frost writes its final pattern.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
